author: 232bama
quote: This is not a Grand Theft Auto game.  Filled with pointless chores, characters are forgettable and boring, no depth in the story.  Grand Theft Auto VI is limited, safe, and preaches at you with a noticeable agenda, all while still committing acts of violence on Law Enforcement, but protecting a certain demographic based on Rockstar woke adopted policies.  Very hypocritical.  GTA used to be satire, dark comedy, edgy, and made fun of all equally.  This is slop.
